title: Frontend: Spiral Matrix Pathfinder
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Spiral Matrix Pathfinder. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(matrix), returning values in clockwise spiral order starting at top-left. Input is a rectangular JSON matrix, possibly empty. Do not duplicate a final single row/column.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Maintain top, bottom, left, and right boundaries.
alternativeApproaches: Return coordinates as well as values and define obstacle behavior as a separate pathfinding problem.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: One row; one column; odd square.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
